people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
translations.bsb: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
translations.kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
translations.asv: And when the voice of the trumpet waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
